measurement_boundary: Loading the selected checkpoint, test-set prediction, metric calculation and saving predictions; excludes training (see evaluated_experiment_id). CodeCarbon machine mode measures the whole computer, so the idle desktop, display output and any other open programs (e.g. TensorBoard, browser) are included; see the idle-baseline run for this fixed background draw.
reuse_notes: Reuses the selected checkpoint of the evaluated training run and cached test features.
notes: Set evaluated_experiment_id and checkpoint_input_path. Test macro-F1 uses the 0-1 scale.
